land.note: the search bar lands; also 'SEO local:' (approved in the 10 s test)

land.big.note: the map card lands, a lower body than the bar

key.note: one take per letter, never the same twice in a row (approved)

key.return.note: Enter: same switch as the letters, its own seed (approved)

tag.note: the 'Top 3' tag: the film's one click voice, its own take (version 3: no pitched pop)

chip.note: version 3, one dry click voice for the chips, the new ranks and the heatmap flips (no triad). Audition v3-click: z +4.0 strong for 'a crisp short plastic click', reads as 'a soft key release click', realness 0.81 (fitted from a CC0 recording); ui_pop/wide C5 read as a snare hit, realness 0.14

exit.note: the list slides away before the calls arrive (reads as a fast whoosh; paper, cloth and velvet read as impact hits)

ding.wa.note: every message from Joaquín, the same tone every time (approved; Joaquín's rule: 'un tono de mensaje que sea monótono, que siempre sea el mismo')

text.note: version 4: one soft air swish per headline line, its peak while the first word rises (high-passed at 400 Hz in sound.py). Audition v4-text: first of 12 for 'a soft quick airy swoosh' (z +2.8, reads 'fast whoosh'), realness 0.98. The finger tap it replaced read as 'a snare drum hit' on 12 of 22 lines in the mix; Joaquín's note: 'no sé si no se sincroniza bien o no hay un buen match'

text.long.note: the same swish, longer, for lines of 4 words or more, so it spans their cascade

tick.note: Google's suggestions, the '...' dot wave and the heatmap rings filling in (rank: plausible, a soft key release click)

scroll.note: the page scrolls down to where your business is (rank: best of 7, reads as a fast whoosh)

send.note: the viewer's own message leaving (audition send, 05-nov: 'a soft short low pop, a message being sent from a phone': third of 9 at z +2.6, reads as 'a mouth pop', fitted from a real recording; ui_pop/soft scored +2.7 but reads 'error buzz' and is the results pop, pro_pop/thup reads 'punchy impact hit')

tock.note: the visto: the two ticks turn blue inside the lens, a dry knock (the approved '#9' knock of the 10 s film: a different material than the pops and dings). Joaquín's ask, 05-nov: 'que tenga también un sonidito el clavado'

puff.note: the puff of smoke Joaquín vanishes in (Joaquín's ask on draft 2 of the talking head: 'aparece un puff y yo desaparezco, y que se escuche el puff'). Audition puff, 05-nov: first of 9 for 'a soft puff of air, a cartoon poof of smoke', z +3.3 strong, reads 'fast whoosh'; pro_whoosh_big/windy tied, cut_hit/air reads as a kick

off.swell: one build per film (earshot's launch rule): the riser into #1 is the one
off.shimmers: version 2: Joaquín did not like the fairy sparkle on the end card ('ese tipo de hadas'); its cousins at #1 and on the gold sweep left with it
off.bell: version 3: the glock climb (E5 G5 C6, C5 on the lockup) and every pitched sequence are out. Joaquín's words on v2: 'suena mucho a tecladito, muy piano, muy dulce, muy soft'; earshot read 0:26-0:40 of v2 as 'upbeat corporate pop music, glockenspiel', and mallet/glock C5 scores realness 0.07
